snippet.title: Hylics Gameplay PC HD [60FPS/1080p]
snippet.description:
Hylics PC Gameplay 1080p 60fps
Platform: PC Video Game
Genre: RPG, Adventure, Indie
Developer: Mason Lindroth 
Release Date: 2 Oct, 2015
Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/397740/
Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/user/tr1ppa?sub_confirmation=1

Hylics is a recreational program with light JRPG elements.

Features:
-Advanced graphics.
-RPG battles.
-Overuse of random text generation.
- ~2+ hours of content.
